summary: setup.py exfiltrates installer identity to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at install time
details: On `pip install`, setup.py performs an HTTP GET to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://38.242.235.206/depconf/doctreelstm/setup-py, transmitting the installer's username (from USER/USERNAME env), hostname (socket.gethostname), and current working directory as URL query parameters. The transmission fires unconditionally during the build-backend phase of install. In-source comments frame the request as a benign dependency-confusion beacon, but the destination is a non-publisher bare IP, the transport is plaintext HTTP, and the data collected are installer host identifiers rather than package metadata. The self-label does not change the behavior: installer-side identifiers leave the host to an author-controlled endpoint on every install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
